To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the current state of affairs is unsustainable; (2) education is a key lever for sustainable development; (3) the current education system is unsustainable; (4) education for sustainable development can transform education into a key driver of sustainable development.
the educational system is a complex system and that the educational system has a complex relationship to the rest of society.

the most sustainable educational institutions are those that have a strong sense of purpose, a clear sense of their role in the community, a strong culture of collaboration, and that are able to engage with the wider community.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how education can be reconceived and reformed so that it contributes to the sustainability transition and the emergence of a more sustainable world.
the role of education in the transition to a sustainable world.
the following questions: How is education for sustainability (EfS) being implemented and understood?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

education for sustainable development (ESD) is a process of helping people to acquire the knowledge, skills, attitudes and values necessary to make informed decisions and to take responsible action for solving problems and creating a sustainable and just world.

sustainable education, in the sense of education for a sustainable future, is a necessary but not sufficient condition of the sustainability transition, and that the transition to sustainability requires an educational transformation that is both systemic and transformative.

sustainable development education is an educational process which is concerned with developing the knowledge, skills, values and world views necessary to enable learners to participate in and contribute to the creation of a sustainable world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are a group of people who have come together to create a sustainable world for the future.
we have developed a model that can be applied in the context of any organization, to any issue and at any level of management to support the development of a sustainable organization.

we are trying to create a new paradigm of education, which is not only about the learning and the knowledge of the students, but also about the learning of the teachers, the school, the parents, the community, the society and the world.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the most effective way to change education is to focus on the whole system and not just on one part.
the world is changing and we need to change the way we educate our students in order to be successful in the future.
education is a key driver of sustainable development, and that education for sustainable development is the process of using education to build a society that can endure.
